_comment: Claude-hooks-format PreToolUse wiring for dsh, consumed via the '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code' cordis row (see profiles/{proxy,headless}/cordis.patch.yml, id: hooks-claude) whose configPath points here. The command invokes jig's own PreToolUse hook — the one evaluator pi's guard.ts and Claude Code use — so every front reads one shared guard policy (domains/dev/llm/harness/policy/guard-rules.json). `--harness dsh` stamps who is asking on every judgment (rules can name principals; the audit log records it). `timeout` is honored by the bridge (hook.timeout -> timeoutSec); a hook that overruns is treated as no opinion by the bridge, so it is kept short.
_absolutePath: The jig invocation below is an absolute main-checkout path on purpose: this is a personal, single-machine dotfiles repo (see domains/dev/config/claude-profiles/personal/hooks/ for the same convention on the Claude Code side), not something meant to be portable across machines. The main checkout's jig needs `bun install --frozen-lockfile` once (it depends on unbash).
_verified: Matcher and payload confirmed against the bridge's source (Phase 0, 2026-09-21): the bridge splits the matcher on '|' and compares tool names exactly; dsh's tools are bash, write, edit, str_replace_editor; the payload carries tool_name/tool_input/session_id/cwd in Claude Code's shape. str_replace_editor sends `path`, which jig reads alongside `file_path`.
